statement.description: To access medical benefits, you must be enrolled in an Obra Social. Remote will enroll you into Obra Social ASE, so you can access medical benefits via Swiss Medical as an employee in Argentina.

Unfortunately, Remote can’t hire employees in a union Obra Social. Please choose a non-union Obra Social and then transfer to that Obra Social. If you’d like to receive medical benefits through Swiss Medical, you must transfer to Obra Social ASE. In order to transfer to a new plan, you must have been enrolled in your current Obra Social for at least a year.
Remote offers medical benefits to all employees in Argentina enrolled in Obra Social ASE. To access these benefits, please transfer to Obra Social ASE.
